purpose: Test whether operating profitability adds economically meaningful and statistically defensible value to Japanese value-plus-momentum portfolios using directly downloaded monthly portfolio returns.

source.return_type: total return including dividends and capital gains

primary_period.interpretation: Post Fama-French five-factor formalization; not claimed as pristine OOS because profitability evidence predates 2015 and the library reconstructs history.

primary_hypothesis: Adding operating profitability to Japanese value-plus-momentum improves net CAGR and information ratio versus the Japanese market in the primary period.
strongest_counter_hypothesis: Operating profitability is redundant, dilutes recent value and momentum returns, or only appears useful because size-balanced portfolios allocate 50% to small stocks.

implementations: size-balanced: 50% small high-characteristic and 50% big high-characteristic
32-portfolio B/M x OP sleeves and high-B/M/high-OP intersection
zero_cost_factor_checks: 60-month trailing inverse-vol HML+Mom versus HML+RMW+Mom, weights lagged one month

cost_scenarios.base: 20 bps at July annual reconstitution for value/profitability sleeves and 20 bps per month for momentum sleeves
cost_scenarios.caveat: These are fixed execution haircuts, not measured portfolio turnover costs.

decision_rule.promote_profitability: Profitability-added big-only or big 32-portfolio strategy has positive excess CAGR versus the corresponding value+momentum strategy, positive HAC point estimate, bootstrap probability of positive annual mean difference >= 0.80, and remains positive under double haircut.
decision_rule.reject_increment: Profitability-added big-only and big 32-portfolio implementations both have non-positive CAGR difference and bootstrap probability <= 0.50 in the primary period.
decision_rule.otherwise: WATCH; use direct J-Quants security-level PIT test before production judgment.

anti_leakage: No parameter optimization after reading results.
Use provider-defined annual B/M and OP formation and monthly momentum formation.
Reconstruct HML, RMW, and Mom from six portfolios and fail if the maximum discrepancy exceeds 3 bps.
All rolling inverse-vol weights use only the prior 60 months and are shifted by one month.
Record raw ZIP SHA-256 hashes and fetch metadata.
